hooks.command: d=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/orchestration && mkdir -p "$d" && f="$d/launch-$$.py" && git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" show origin/master:scripts/orchestration/launch.py > "$f" && python "$f" --project "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" slot hook-create; r=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $r

d=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/orchestration && mkdir -p "$d" && f="$d/launch-$$.py" && git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" show origin/master:scripts/orchestration/launch.py > "$f" && python "$f" --project "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" slot hook-remove; r=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $r
